focus_areas: Texture realism of the knit pattern (yarn definition vs. printed look)
Boundary sharpness between denim and sock fabric
Anatomical correctness of the toes within the sock (separation vs. melting)
Contact shadows and grounding of the feet on the carpet
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'toe separation' issue. In real photos, you can often see the outline of individual toes through thin socks. If the AI has merged them into a smooth blob, this is a structural defect. Also, verify if the stripe distortion follows the 3D geometry of the foot correctly, or if it looks like a 2D texture mapped onto a 3D shape without proper warping.
image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a pair of feet wearing colorful striped socks (pink and yellow/orange horizontal stripes). The feet are resting on a textured beige carpet. The bottom hem of blue denim jeans is visible at the ankles, partially covering the top of the socks. The socks appear to be crew-length or ankle-length, conforming to the shape of the feet.

expert_testimonies.reason: To ensure the feet are properly grounded on the carpet with correct contact shadows and depth ordering, preventing a 'floating' appearance.
To confirm the object class is indeed 'sock' and not a similar footwear item like a bootie or slipper, and to assess the realism of the textile appearance.
To rigorously check the boundary between the denim jeans and the sock for fusion artifacts or unnatural blending, which was noted as a potential issue.
To evaluate the overall photorealism, specifically looking for inconsistencies in lighting shadows under the feet and the naturalness of the carpet texture interaction.
